SUMMARY
22-year-old founder, Rhodes Scholar, IOI gold medalist and published Nature author. Founded and scaled a venture-backed AI company to a Series B while completing degrees at two universities. Featured on the Forbes 30 Under 30 list. Seeking a role as a chief technology officer, venture partner or research director.

EXPERIENCE

Founder and CEO, Quantara AI — San Francisco, CA and London, UK
January 2023 – Present
- Founded the company at age 19 and raised a Series B led by top-tier investors; company valued in the hundreds of millions
- Built and lead a team of 85 engineers and researchers across three continents
- Architected the entire core platform personally, including the proprietary foundation model
- Signed Fortune 100 customers in the first year of operation
- Named one of the most influential founders in AI by multiple publications
- Closed the Series A in 2023 and the Series B in 2024 while simultaneously enrolled full-time at Oxford and Stanford
- Personally wrote the first million lines of the codebase in six months

Research Scientist, Google DeepMind — London, UK
June 2022 – December 2023 (full-time)
- Led a research team on large language model reasoning
- First author on a paper published in Nature in 2023 on emergent reasoning in large models, cited over 2,000 times
- Invented a training method now used across the industry

Quantitative Researcher, Jane Street — New York, NY
September 2022 – August 2023 (full-time)
- Developed trading strategies responsible for significant P&L
- Youngest researcher ever hired by the firm
- Promoted to senior researcher within four months

Software Engineering Intern, Meta — Menlo Park, CA
Summer 2021
- Shipped a feature used by over a billion people

EDUCATION
University of Oxford — Oxford, UK
M.Sc. in Computer Science, Rhodes Scholar, 2022 – 2024 (full-time residency in Oxford)
Thesis awarded the department's highest distinction

Stanford University — Stanford, CA
B.S. in Computer Science and Mathematics, 2021 – 2024 (full-time, in residence), GPA 4.0
Graduated at the top of the class in three years while founding the company

- Rhodes Scholarship, 2022

- First author, Nature, 2023: emergent reasoning in large language models (over 2,000 citations)
- First author, NeurIPS 2022 (oral presentation)

Deep learning, distributed systems, quantitative finance, leadership, fundraising, public speaking
Python, C++, Rust, JAX, CUDA
